Enum Class WorkloadType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<WorkloadType>
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.enums.WorkloadType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<WorkloadType>, Constable
public enum WorkloadType extends Enum<WorkloadType>
Pre-defined workload archetypes with built-in infrastructure profiles. Each constant carries a default WorkloadProfile that the optimizer uses when no explicit profile override is provided.

Use CUSTOM with a user-supplied WorkloadProfile for workloads not covered by the built-in types.

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    AI_ML_INFERENCE
    Model serving: HIGH latency sensitivity, high power density required.
    AI_ML_TRAINING
    Model training: MEDIUM latency sensitivity, high power density and liquid cooling required.
    BIG_DATA_ANALYTICS
    Batch analytics: MEDIUM latency sensitivity, high power density required.
    COLD_BACKUP
    Archival storage: LOW latency sensitivity.
    CUSTOM
    No built-in profile (getDefaultProfile() is null); supply a WorkloadProfile on the workload.
    DISASTER_RECOVERY
    Warm standby/DR: LOW latency sensitivity — distance from users is acceptable.
    EDGE_COMPUTE
    Edge processing close to users: CRITICAL latency sensitivity, proximity-weighted placement.
    GENERAL_COMPUTE
    The default archetype: MEDIUM latency sensitivity, no facility requirements.
    REALTIME_COLLABORATION
    Voice/video/screen-share: CRITICAL latency sensitivity, proximity-weighted placement.
    TRANSACTIONAL
    OLTP and payment-style systems: HIGH latency sensitivity.
